products.title: Silk Straight Bundles
products.description: Our Silk Straight bundles fall like liquid silk and hold a mirror shine from root to tip. Raw Vietnamese hair, double drawn so the ends are as full as the roots — no thin, wispy finish.

specs.origin: Vietnam — raw, single-donor hair, cuticles aligned

care: Co-wash weekly with a sulphate-free shampoo; detangle from the ends upwards.
Seal with a light serum and air-dry where you can.
Sleep in a silk scarf or bonnet to keep the cuticle smooth.

products.title: Silk Straight HD Lace Wig
products.summary: 13×4 HD lace that melts into every skin tone.
products.description: A ready-to-wear silk straight unit on transparent HD lace, pre-plucked with a natural hairline and bleached knots. Fitted to your measurements or cap size, so it sits flat and secure from the first wear.

specs.origin: Vietnam — raw, single-donor hair, cuticles aligned
specs.laceType: 13×4 HD lace frontal, pre-plucked, bleached knots

care: Wash every 10–14 wears; let it air-dry on a wig stand.
Use a lace-safe adhesive remover and never pull at the lace.
Store on a stand or in its silk bag between wears.

products.title: Sleek Straight Ponytail
products.summary: Instant length and drama in under five minutes.
products.description: A drawstring ponytail in silk straight hair with two hidden combs, so it sits high and secure all evening. Wrap the attached strand around the base for an invisible finish.

specs.origin: Vietnam — raw, single-donor hair, cuticles aligned

care: Brush gently from the ends upwards.
Wash only when needed; hang to dry.
Store in its silk bag to prevent tangling.
